title: /(verification-evidence)/api/video-flags
responsibility: List exact-owner reviewer frame flags and accept bounded same-origin JSON feedback against attached verified clips.

inputs.name: GET.url
inputs.description: Request URL containing the owner/flag query parameters documented by this endpoint.

inputs.name: POST.request
inputs.description: Same-origin JSON request. The actual streamed body is capped at 8192 bytes before parsing.

inputs.name: POST.url
inputs.description: Request URL whose origin is compared with the submitted Origin header.

inputs.name: readFlagRequest.request
inputs.description: JSON request whose Origin, Content-Type and actual streamed length are checked before its input is admitted.

inputs.name: readFlagRequest.origin
inputs.description: Exact expected origin from the request URL; cross-origin submissions return a 403 response.

outputs.name: GET
outputs.description: JSON flags for the requested owner/current slot.

outputs.name: POST
outputs.description: A 201 JSON flag after exact attached-clip validation, or a documented JSON error response.

outputs.name: readFlagRequest
outputs.description: The bounded parsed FrameFlagInput or an explicit HTTP validation response.

errors.name: HTTP 400
errors.description: Invalid owner, current-slot parameters, input JSON or attached evidence/integrity produces a JSON error response.

errors.name: HTTP 403
errors.description: Origin differs from the request URL origin.

errors.name: HTTP 413
errors.description: Declared or streamed request body exceeds 8192 bytes.
